input: scheduled: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products

doc_friction.issue: quality_mutate.py runs its test command from the venture directory, so a repo-root relative path makes the baseline fail with a message that doesn't say why; its --help says so, the playbook example doesn't.

deviations.why: It calls calculators a poor use of a run. This is a code-procedure engine whose drift chain (cap, widening, truncation, governing case) chat answers get wrong, and it fills an input three construction tools lacked.
deviations.did: built it anyway, under the construction direction
deviations.result: merged with tests against hand calcs

notes: Explore idea: roof-snow-load-calculator, an ASCE 7-16 Chapter 7 roof snow load engine (flat, sloped via all three Fig. 7.4-1 panels, minimum, rain-on-snow, unbalanced gable, leeward/windward step drift with hc cap, 8hc limit and far-edge truncation, parapet/RTU drift, sliding snow, ice dams) with a drawn step section. Chosen because shed-designer, open-house-plans and continuous-beam-calculator all asked the user for a snow load nothing computed. Checks run here: 29 node tests against hand calculations; quality_mutate caught 4 of 5 seeded bugs (the fifth, pm at pg=20, is equivalent); rendered in Chromium (example, phone width, error path, no console errors); register-tool clean; venture-preflight --skip-build found a catch-all-section overflow and a 185-char post description, both fixed. Not checked against a commercial program; ASCE 7-16 only, not 7-22. Next: let shed-designer take pg and exposure and use this engine.
